title: Source registry
description: data/sources.yaml (and paper/references-extra.yaml, docs/methodology-references.yaml): one entry per URL. Prose cites a source as `[@slug]`; renderers turn it into `[title](url)`.

title.description: Canonical link title, verbatim from edition 9 (section 9's wording first, then 4, 12, 11, 10). Other titles used for the same URL are per-use overrides (`source_titles`/`reference_titles`).

url.description: The linked URL, verbatim (for a copy: the copy that was read).

kind.description: Edition 9 section 1: primary = standard, regulation, document of a regulator or professional body, original paper or report, or a word-for-word copy of one; secondary = encyclopedia, blog, vendor or trade page, topic aggregator, news article.

publisher.description: Publisher of the document (for a faithful copy: of the original, when edition 9 names it); null if unknown.

year.description: Year as stated in the edition-9 link title; null if the title states none.

title.description: Name of the site that hosts the copy.

url.description: Optional. URL of the copy that was read, only when it differs from `url` (in data/sources.yaml `url` is always the copy, so it is omitted).

via.description: Optional. Present when the primary text was read through a faithful copy.

paid.description: True when the document's full text is paid (the linked page may be a free catalogue page or sample).

accessed.description: ISO date (quoted string in YAML) the source was last checked, or null if not recorded. Edition 9 records 2026-10-14 for the sources of section 11's quotes.

notes.description: Classification remarks; judgments are labelled as such.
